column7: A third-party database client that panics on a malformed server reply is contained as ErrEngineClientPanic (#4133), but the contained panic's value went to the server log in full (redacted only for DSNs), and such a value can embed the bytes of the reply that broke the parser. The log now carries the message of a runtime error (indices and lengths) and only the Go type of any other value, plus the redacted stack. Red before the change (the marker bytes appeared in the log), green after. The hostile-target matrix TestHostileTargetNeverPanicsIntoCaller gained the COPY sub-protocol, prepared-statement and multi-result frames of the H6 hostile-server report.
